summary: Iteration 6 focused testing of new features (Liked-you strip, top-givers card, chat avatars) + light chat regression. Backend pytest 6/6 pass. Frontend UI verified: premium user sees Liked-you strip with count/like-back and NO CTA; free user sees blurred photo + lock + 'Unlock with Premium' CTA that navigates to /wallet?premium=1 and no like-back button. Chat sidebar/header render avatars (not initials); header name/avatar navigate to /profile/{id}. ProfileView shows Top givers card only when gifts_count>0 (present on Bob with 🪙 150 total; not shown on partner Xena with no gifts); giver card click navigates to their /profile/{id}. Backend confirms free /likes/received omits name/age, premium exposes them, and like-back both creates a match and removes the liker from the strip.

issues: Console still emits Radix 'Missing Description or aria-describedby' warning — carried over from iter5, not regressed

critical_code_review_comments: server.py likes_received (line 594): loads matches per request with to_list(500) and does an O(N) per-like users.find_one. For accounts with many pending likers this is N+1 queries — batch via `$in` on user ids instead.

server.py profile_detail top_givers aggregation (line 558): calls `.to_list(1000)` on all gift senders and then does per-top-3 find_one. Include the giver name/photo via `$lookup` in the same aggregation to save 3 extra round-trips.

Matches.jsx (line 42): free-user photo still gets a real src url with only CSS blur — the underlying source image URL is fully accessible in DOM/network. If names are hidden for privacy, consider not sending photo URLs either (or a low-res proxy). Currently /likes/received returns `photos[:1]` in the clear even for free users.

ProfileView.jsx (line 94): uses `top_givers.map((g,i) => ... ["border-amber-400","border-slate-300","border-amber-700"][i])` with an index. If backend ever returns >3 items (currently capped at 3) the ranking colors/emojis would be undefined — add explicit slice(0,3) on the client for defense.
Chats.jsx (line 82): extra thumbnails `partner.photos.slice(1, 5)` render up to 4 header thumbs but no accessible label/alt text — set alt to `${partner.name} photo ${i+1}`.
server.py likes_received does not paginate — 200-record hard cap could hide older likers silently. Consider `limit`/`skip` query params or scoped by unread state.
